name: Ronak Shah
player_statement:
A complete player, Ronak Shah has made a big mark in cricket. With 14 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 78, with an average of 15.75 and a quick strike rate of 178.30. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 17 sixes and 8 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 31.4 overs, taking 15 wickets at an economy rate of 7.67. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
